purpose: Make assumptions missing from owner INPUTS/METHOD explicit; these are inferred conventions, not newly sourced measurements.
AF163_density_basis: Owner names 1250 kg/m3 only for scarf adhesive. Reusing it for the full-area bond reproduces the filed known-solids volume. Actual AF163 cured density and bondline geometry remain unverified.
core_void_basis: Subtract 0.2945010968475796 m3 of full-area AF film and 0.012181226862401973 m3 of splice from A*t_core-core_mass/2700. This exactly explains the first independent comparison's 0.3066823237099854 m3 difference. Whether the full film occupies the quoted core envelope is not established by a manufactured section.
Kapton_inventory_basis: Explicitly named and valued in owner RESULTS sources, absent as a configurable numerical input in INPUTS. Included as a declared reconstruction assumption only.
